svg.text: REVIEW: ONE-FOOT BENCH MODELED WITH TWO 0.5-FOOT RISERS PER ACCESS
Three two-riser stepways occupy actual plan edges. Their 1.25 ft treads and 0.5 ft risers are fictional geometry.
A uniform roof height ABOVE THE LOCAL FLOOR cannot be silently recast as a shared roof elevation.
Counterfactual ramp grades are for comparison only; no physical survey, certified accessibility or stability.
